spans.s:
तुच् m. f. Ved. Offspring,
children.

तुच्छ a.
1 Empty, void, vain,
light.
--2 Small, little, trifling.
--3
Abandoned, deserted.
--4 Low,
mean, insignificant, contemptible,
worthless.
--5 Poor, miserable,
wretched.
--च्छं Chaff.
--Comp.
--द्रुः the castor-oil tree.
--धान्यः
--धान्यकः straw, chaff.

तुच्छयति Den. P. To make empty
or poor;

तुच्छीकृ {c8c} U. To despise, slight,
contemn.
